_readme: Snapshot of Talbott's GHL custom values used by the webinar pages (build-time fallback). Refreshed from GHL on every build when GHL_API_TOKEN + GHL_LOCATION_ID are set in Vercel; at runtime /api/custom-values serves the live values and site.js swaps them in, so editing the custom value in GHL updates the site within about a minute. Do not edit by hand.
